name: Alovera (Spain)
description: Green field with a blue wavy band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alovera (a castle, a tree and a lion).
history: The flag of Alovera was approved on 26 January 2018 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 8 February 2018; it is a green rectangular cloth of 2:3 crossed by a blue wavy diagonal band edged white, with the municipal arms at the centre.
